title: Creeper Launcher
description: Mod that makes launches you when a creeper explodes, instead of you taking damage.
body:
A custom-made mod to prevent creeper griefing, with a twist - You don't take damage, at least not from the explosion, but watch out for the fall.

Sends you and other entities flying when a creeper explodes! For more fun, because what else would you do when the sky is the limit!
